subject: [RFC PATCH v2 09/18] mm/memory-failure: handle folios with PG_rcu_free

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch addresses an issue where memory_failure() and soft_offline_page() cannot handle pages that are waiting for an RCU (Read-Copy-Update) grace period, which causes them to be ignored or handled incorrectly. The patch introduces a new function mf_free_rcu_pages() that frees these pages before attempting to access them, ensuring they are properly handled by memory_failure(). Additionally, it modifies the get_any_page() and memory_failure() functions to wait for an RCU grace period after setting PG_hwpoison on a page, allowing readers to safely unmap the poisoned page. This patch aims to improve the handling of pages waiting for an RCU grace period in the Linux kernel's memory failure mechanism.
